### Attack Rating (AR) Modifiers Summary

* All smartlinked weapons have +3 AR (Smartgun + network bonus) (Red Fox).
* All drone mounted weapons have +2 AR (drone mount AR bonus) (Red Fox, Tesla Coil).
* All held/melee weapons (Amalgam Cestas (+2)) have personalized grips.

## Tesla Coil & Spray Attack Protocols{#tesla-spray-protocols}

Reference: *Body Shop* (p. 49) & *SR6 Core Seattle* (p. 117) / *Lethal Harvest* (p. 145)

The cyberarm-mounted Tesla Coil operates as an exotic ranged thrower using the Shadowrun 6e Flamethrower / Spray Attack rules. It draws from an internal 5-shot capacitor bank (`5(c)`). It features three distinct discharge profiles, with drone/cyberarm mounting stability adding **+2 AR** across all active ranges:

1. **Straight Attack**: Direct stream against a single target (the first valid target on a 20m line of fire; anyone crossing the line is also affected). Base **5S(e)** damage with **10 / 12 / — / — / —** effective AR.
2. **Wobbly Attack**: Discharges a fluctuating electrical arc across an **$8.58^\circ$ apex cone** (covering a 3-meter wide area at 20m max range). Increases Attack Rating by +2 (**12 / 14 / — / — / —** effective AR) and decreases Damage Value by 1 (**4S(e)**). All valid targets in the 3m area are affected.
3. **Sweeping Attack**: Sweeps an intense electrical arc across a **$28.07^\circ$ apex cone** (covering a 10-meter wide area at 20m max range). Increases Attack Rating by +4 (**14 / 16 / — / — / —** effective AR) and decreases Damage Value by 3 (**2S(e)**). All valid targets in the 10m area are affected.
4. **Wild Die Acceleration**: On either a Wobbly or Sweeping attack, Reiko may elect to move the stream extra fast by substituting a **Wild Die** for one normal die from her Exotic Weapons dice pool.

## Amalgam & Grey Mana Technology (GMT) Alloy Protocols{#amalgam-protocols}

Reference: *Scotophobia* (p. 181)

### 1. Overcoming Immunity to Normal Weapons (ItNW)

* **Mechanic**: When attacking any materialized spirit, critter, or entity possessing the **Immunity to Normal Weapons (ItNW)** power using an **Amalgam / GMT Alloy** weapon (e.g. *Amalgam Cestas*), the Essence-based Hardened Armor provided by the immunity is treated as **normal armor** instead of hardened armor.
* **Effect**: Armor dice do not automatically convert to automatic hits, allowing normal damage penetration without requiring spellcasting or adept weapon foci.

### 2. Wild Die & Durability

* **Attack Test Wild Die**: Replace one normal die with a **Wild Die** on all attack tests made with GMT / Amalgam weapons.
* **Misfire / Damage Condition**: If the Wild Die rolls a **1**, the alloy weapon suffers structural damage and cannot be used or retracted until repaired.
* **Repair Procedure**: Requires an armorer facility/shop and an extended **Engineering (Armorer) + Logic (6, 1 hour)** test.

### 3. Disian Entity Bonuses

* **Disian Chimeras**: +4 AR bonus on attack tests.
* **Disian Shells**: +4 AR bonus and +2 DV bonus on attack tests.

## Firing Mode & Attack Rating Rules

### 1. Firing Mode Summary (SR6 Core p. 109 & Double Clutch p. 142)

* **Single Shot (SS)**: 1 round fired. Base DV, 0 AR penalty.
* **Semi-Automatic (SA Burst)**: 2 rounds fired. Adds **+1 DV**. Standard -2 AR penalty (halved to **-1 AR** on vehicle/drone mounts).
* **Burst Fire (BF Narrow)**: 4 rounds fired. Adds **+2 DV**. Standard -4 AR penalty (halved to **-2 AR** on vehicle/drone mounts).

### 2. Attack Rating (AR) Modifications

* **Smartlink System (+3 AR Total)**
  * Smartgun systems increase the attack rating by 2 across all available range categories (SR6 p. 261)
  * Wireless bonus: +1 dice pool to attack tests (applied as an 'other' modifier to Reiko's Targeting autosoft pools). Gain bonus minor action when reloading or changing device mode (SR6 p. 261)
  * M-TOC: +1 AR for all linked smartguns. (FS p. 90)
* **Personalized Grip (+1 / +2 AR)**: Custom grip adds +1 AR to Close & Near ranges for ranged weapons, +2 AR for melee.
* **Vehicle / Drone Mount (+2 AR, Halve Burst Penalty)**: Mounted weapons gain +2 AR and halve burst fire AR penalties (*Double Clutch* p. 142).
* **Link-Firing Bonus (+1 AR, +2 DV)**: When spending a Minor Action to link-fire, adds +1 AR and +2 DV per secondary weapon (*Double Clutch* p. 142). If Reiko does not spend the Minor Action, weapons fire independently in Single Mode with standard AR (+5 total: Smartlink + Mount).

### 3. Laser Weapon Ammunition & Batteries (Firing Squad p. 44)

* **Peak-Discharge Batteries**:
  * **Red Fox**: 30 shots per Peak-Discharge Battery Clip (100¥). Uses Wild Die on attack tests.
* **Field Ammunition**: Yuriko carries 5x Peak-Discharge Battery Clips (500¥ total).
